name: Faisal
story_so_far: I survived a shipwreck and washed up on this island with four strangers: Reem, Khalid, Noura, and Salem. On Day 2, I injured my ankle, leaving me unable to forage. Khalid also injured his ankle on Day 4, leaving us both incapacitated. Food is incredibly scarce; we have struggled every day, often with only one or two pieces of food for five people. Noura has been honest and diligent, but she injured her ankle today and can no longer help. Reem is inconsistent; she found one piece of food today, but her absences worry me. Salem has been my primary source of hope, constantly promising me we would eat and offering encouragement, though his promises haven't resulted in food for me yet. My health is declining rapidly due to starvation, dropping from 8/10 to 2/10 over the last few days. I feel useless and fragile, watching the others struggle while I slowly waste away.

Reem.note: I worry about her because she spends a lot of time away and only brought back one piece of food today.

Khalid.note: He tried to lead, but now he is just as injured and helpless as I am.

Noura.note: She has always been honest about our situation, but now she is injured and cannot help us search.

Salem.note: He is the only one who gives me hope with his kind words, even if the food hasn't arrived yet.

plans: I plan to try and rest and hope my body can hold on, as I am too weak to do anything but wait for the others to bring food.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and honestly quite frightening. We are all still strangers, and the reality of our situation is setting in. We managed to find some food, but it's nowhere near enough for five people. I feel a constant knot of anxiety in my stomach thinking about tomorrow. I just hope we can find a way to sustain ourselves.

Today was a nightmare of helplessness. My ankle is throbbing, and being unable to move while the others hunt makes me feel like a burden. We only had two pieces of food for five people, and I'm terrified of what happens if tomorrow is just as empty. I watched Khalid and Reem come back, but the hunger is already setting in. I just hope we can all sleep without the dread of starvation keeping us awake.

My stomach is cramping from the emptiness, and my ankle is still giving me trouble. Today was even more discouraging than yesterday; we only managed to find two pieces of food between the five of us. I watched Khalid and Noura come back with so little, and I'm terrified for what happens if the others return empty-handed too. I feel so useless just sitting here watching everyone else struggle. I hope I can find some strength to keep going tomorrow.

Another day of nothingness, and my body is starting to fail me. My ankle is still throbbing, but it's the hollow ache in my stomach that's truly terrifying. Salem managed to find two pieces of food today, which is better than yesterday, but it's still not nearly enough for five people. I feel so incredibly weak, and seeing Khalid also go down with an injured ankle makes me fear for our collective future. I'm losing hope that we can sustain this.

My body feels so heavy, and the hunger is no longer just an ache—it's a dull, constant throb that drains my very spirit. Salem keeps trying to reassure me, promising we will eat tonight, but I haven't seen any food yet. I feel so incredibly fragile, and my ankle is a constant reminder of my helplessness. I'm terrified that if I close my eyes, I might not have the strength to open them again.

I am so scared. My body feels like it is fading away, and the hunger is a hollow, crushing weight in my chest. Today, Noura hurt her ankle, and now we have even fewer people who can move or find food. Reem only brought back one piece of food, which isn't enough to sustain any of us. I am lying here in the dark, terrified that I won't wake up tomorrow.
